written.headline: Microsoft completes pre‑training of 2.8 trillion‑parameter MAI‑Base‑2 model
written.summary: Microsoft announced that its MAI‑Base‑2 model, with 2.8 trillion total parameters and 80 billion active parameters, finished pre‑training after 38 days on 16,000 GB200 GPUs. The model uses a mixture‑of‑experts architecture and is claimed to be up to 12 times more compute‑efficient than leading rivals.

written.headline: UK government announces over £600 million AI security funding package
written.summary: The UK government unveiled a policy package of more than £600 million to fund AI safety, cyber defence and biosecurity initiatives. The plan includes £165 million for a new AI Biosecurity Lab and up to £200 million in AI model usage credits from OpenAI and Anthropic.
